# SALVO by Pasta Fresca

> > A casual, family-friendly Italian restaurant in Singapore serving authentic Napoli-style pizzas, fresh pasta, and Italian cuisine with pet-friendly dining options.

Founded by Carecci Salvatore, SALVO by Pasta Fresca operates locations at PLQ3 and Tanjong Katong, offering dine-in, delivery, and affordable lunch promotions. The restaurant specializes in authentic Italian dishes including fresh pasta, Napoli-style pizzas, and vegetarian-friendly options in a welcoming alfresco dining atmosphere.
